title: Does the hub's own skill change the result?
summary: The same brief and renderer, with the vendor's skills alone and with the hub's contract-first-video skill added. One run each, scored by the checker and a blind reviewer.
verified: Ran on 2026-11-12 on an Apple M3 Max (64 GB, macOS), ffmpeg 7.1.1. The vendor-only clip is the HyperFrames arm of the first example. The with-skill clip was made by a fresh Claude subagent the same day. The driver ran clipcheck on both committed clips and one blind reviewer agent scored them.
runtime: about 2 s per clip to check; the with-skill agent run took 9.9 minutes
key_result: The clip made with the skill had no checker errors on its real defects and scored 10/12 against 9/12 from one blind reviewer. It was cleaner and plainer: exact copy, no broken frames, but transitions that read as cuts. Below the 2-point threshold set beforehand.
threshold: Pass: zero clipcheck errors under the hub's reference contract and at least 2 points above the vendor-only clip out of 12 from a blind reviewer. Narrowed: zero errors and 0 or 1 point higher. Fail: a checker error, or a lower score.
